_comment: Stalwart 0.16.22's Permission enum, as GET /api/schema serves it (enums.Permission).
The server's own list is what the Roles screen shows; this copy is what the translations are checked against,
so a language that misses a permission, or keeps one Stalwart no longer has, fails a test.
